name: dsh-onboarding-agent-brief

doNotConfuseWith.name: Deep Code / deepseek code
doNotConfuseWith.note: 第三方开源 CLI，被官方 API 文档收录，不是 DSH

doNotConfuseWith.name: community fork
doNotConfuseWith.note: 各种 <user>/deepseek-harness 魔改发行版，跟随上游

doNotConfuseWith.name: name-squat lookalikes
doNotConfuseWith.note: 与 @deepseek-ai/dsh 只差一两个字母，安装前核对 scope

definitions.profile: 产品形态：web / headless / acp / sdk / sdk-minimal
definitions.bundle: 一组插件的预设配置，如 @deepseek-ai/dsh-base + @deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app
definitions.patch: YAML 顶层数组的覆盖层，按 id 改配置 / disabled / insert 新插件
definitions.rule: 在 dsh 里加功能 = 写 patch 或装 bundle，不是改源码

mentalModel.launcherArgRule: launcher parses its own flags; after the first unrecognized token everything is forwarded to the profile app

paths.profileRoot: ~/.dsh/profiles/<name>/cordis.yml (rewritten on every boot; do not edit)
paths.hooksBridge: ~/.dsh/hooks.json (filtered copy, loaded once at process start)

web.note: client-* / ui-* 界面插件都在这一层

headless.note: 一次性任务，最终答案 stdout

sdk.note: JSON-RPC stdio; sdk-minimal 是极简树

patchExamples.hooksBridge:
- id: hooks-claude-code
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-hooks-claude-code'
  config:
    configPath: /Users/you/.dsh/hooks.json
    defaultTimeoutMs: 15000

patchReload.live: watch patch files, changes take effect immediately (triggers front-end HMR)
patchReload.startup: apply once at boot; requires restart after edits

permissionModes.workspaceRoot: process.cwd() — start dsh in the directory you want writable

pluginInstallPitfalls.symptom: Failed to write cafs: Failed to create the parent directory at '~/Library/pnpm/store/v11/files/...': Operation not permitted; dsh: pnpm failed in profile directory ...
pluginInstallPitfalls.cause: dsh's own file sandbox blocks writes outside the session workspace; pnpm's global store is outside
pluginInstallPitfalls.fix: run dsh plugin add in the user's normal terminal, or point pnpm store-dir inside the workspace; do not retry blindly

pluginInstallPitfalls.symptom: build scripts of cloudflared / cpu-features / node-pty / ssh2 blocked
pluginInstallPitfalls.cause: pnpm >= 10 does not run third-party build/prepare scripts by default
pluginInstallPitfalls.fix: add exact keys under allowBuilds in ~/.dsh/profiles/<name>/pnpm-workspace.yaml, then re-run

pluginInstallPitfalls.symptom: Cannot find package '@linxin666/dsh-...' when starting dsh web
pluginInstallPitfalls.cause: pnpm isolated linking nests some subpackages
pluginInstallPitfalls.fix: set nodeLinker: hoisted (and autoInstallPeers: false) in the profile's pnpm-workspace.yaml, reinstall

pluginInstallPitfalls.symptom: a freshly published package resolves to an older version

knownFailureModes.symptom: dsh web tab freezes for minutes then recovers
knownFailureModes.evidence: measured 2026-09-21: 62 client bundles, ~16.6MB uncompressed, 6 ESTABLISHED Chrome->3080 connections (HTTP/1.1 same-origin limit), server Send-Q up to ~7.9MB
knownFailureModes.cause: many UI plugins + SSE long connections exhaust Chrome's 6-connection budget; HMR/restart re-downloads the bundle
mitigations: do not open multiple dsh tabs
consider patchReload: startup to avoid mid-session HMR

knownFailureModes.symptom: right sidebar shows code/blank instead of image/pdf preview
knownFailureModes.cause: dsh-better-sidebar registers dsh-resource://file/** at extension priority, outranking the built-in text preview (fallback)

knownFailureModes.symptom: dsh works in terminal but a GUI/daemon reports it cannot verify the version, or dsh --version prints nothing
knownFailureModes.cause: GUI PATH hits an old node (e.g. /usr/local/bin/node v16); dsh shim is #!/usr/bin/env node; pnpm/corepack spawned by dsh hits the same old node
knownFailureModes.fix: wrap dsh with a launcher that execs an absolute Node 22 and unconditionally prepends that Node's bin dir to PATH

knownFailureModes.symptom: after enabling TUN, dsh API calls time out / reset
knownFailureModes.cause: Clash GLOBAL mode ignores rules and sends DSH direct traffic overseas
knownFailureModes.fix: TUN + rule mode; DOMAIN rules to DIRECT for api.deepseek.com and api.moonshot.cn; never use global mode

knownFailureModes.symptom: http://localhost:3080 unreachable but http://127.0.0.1:3080 works under TUN
knownFailureModes.fix: add localhost to fake-ip-filter; verify with `dscacheutil -q host -a name localhost`

agentDiscipline: align on the goal before acting; ask what 'smooth' means and why the switch is happening
report progress in stages; stop before kill/restart/config writes
review third-party plugin code and npm scope before install
avoid full UI bundles; install only needed sub-plugins
verifyChecklist: dsh web --port 0 --no-open  # boot smoke test, Ctrl+C
